text:
alex: Heads-up — the nightly sequence-length sweep found a regression we should triage. Ampere pick switched to q4_0-ampere-opt for seqlen=1024 with KV cache on and median latency is +12.4% vs yesterday. CSV here: http://ci.redwood.internal/artifacts/seqscan/1719990000/summary.csv :eyes:
ci-bot: sweep job 1719990000 finished. configs tested: [q4_0-ampere-opt, q4_1-ampere-fallback, fp16-ampere]. sample command: `./bench/run_seq_sweep --model gpt-small --seqlen 1024 --kv on --repeat 50`
maria: ugh. Is the regression isolated to the q4_0 variant or to the autotuner selection logic?
alex: looks like q4_0 only. q4_1 and fp16 are stable. Regression correlates with path that uses contiguous-kv-populate + large-batch-prefetch.
jamal: can you paste an example microbench output? trying to see where tokens/ms changed.
alex: sure — paste below:
```
# microbench excerpt (seqlen=1024, kv=on)
kernel: q4_0-ampere-opt
median latency: 18.2 ms/token
p95 latency: 24.7 ms/token
baseline (yesterday): median 16.2 ms/token
delta: +12.345%\n```

nora: interesting — the perf profile shows much more time in the attention kvcache write path. suspect a codegen change in the q4_0 kernel that increases memory stalls for long seqlen.
patrick: the autotuner recently added an ampere-specific heuristic that prefers q4_0 when seqlen >= 768 and batch_size <= 8. maybe the heuristic pushed it through without enough microbench coverage.
maria: can we reproduce locally on perf-lab? alex, can you push the exact run args + seed? I can run a tiled perf trace.
alex: run args: `--model gpt-small --device ampere --quant q4_0 --seqlen 1024 --kv on --batch 4 --repeats 50 --trace perflab` — I'm uploading the trace: http://ci.redwood.internal/traces/1719990000/trace.tar.gz
jamal: I'll pull the trace and run `nvprof`/nsys to validate stalls. If it's memory-bound we should see L2 miss spike and long global mem latency.
nora: short-term mitigation: revert autotuner rule for ampere q4_0 at seqlen >= 768, mark it 'needs-more-samples' in the pick DB. We should also add seqlen=1024 to the microbench candidate set for q4_0 in CI.
patrick: I can add a gating patch to perf CI: if median delta > 8% for a candidate kernel vs the previous pick, fail the autotune landing. Also add automated KV-on runs in nightly sweep for long seqlen.
maria: good – also add a sampling config in the harness to exercise contiguous-kv-populate path specifically (small batch + long seqlen). That was the blind spot.
alex: I created a quick repro job: http://ci.redwood.internal/jobs/1719990000/repro. If someone can validate the trace by EOD we can either keep q4_0 blocked or ship a microfix/rollback in autotune.
ci-bot: created ticket PERF-1189: 'ampere q4_0 seqlen=1024 regression — block pick & add KV-longseq microbench'. assignees: jamal, nora. link: http://tracker.redwood/PERF-1189
jamal: starting deeper profiling now. will post nsys results. if it's a codegen pattern I'll try a tiny kernel tweak and re-run microbench.
nora: also add to the nightly matrix a variant with `kv=off` vs `kv=on` for long seqlen, so autotuner can see the delta automatically. small change but helps catch these.
patrick: noted. I'll submit a CI gating PR and an autotune rule revert PR. tagging @maria for perf trace validation.
maria: got it — running now. expect nsys output in ~30m. :coffee:
alex: thanks all. let's aim to have a mitigation decision by EOD PST. :thumbsup:
